summary: Deep Assassination Mutilate with Seal Fate, Relentless Strikes, Venom and Opportunity, on two daggers.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when it's down. Refresh it when it's about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less. Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points when Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ energy, or with under 6s left. Spend leftover points in the last 3s
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer. A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld the same way
Shank on cooldown at 75 energy or less (25 Energy back; with Venom it keeps the poisons' buff up)
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Round 70753: the November 2 notes' rogue rework isn't in client 70753, so Shank, the new talents and the re-ranked ones take the notes' values (standards 37). Shank's damage details are assumed (notes.md, Rogue).
Seal Fate Daggers uses Backstab with the same talents, and is 13 DPS ahead.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Backstab and Eviscerate stop at rank VIII and Deadly Poison at IV. The books would add 13 to 18 DPS.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add about 8 and 6 DPS.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. The flask gives its full bonus only there.
10% hit (10 hit rating each on the wrist and second ring). Hit past the 8% cap still helps white hits, so 10% beats 8% by 0.4 to 1.9 DPS.
No Goblin Land Mine. Its 1s cast resets the swing, so it loses DPS. The Sapper stays.
